definitions.explanation: The act of transporting goods or cargo from one place to another, typically by vehicle or ship.

examples.japanese: {運送|うんそう}{会社|かいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{頼|たの}む。
{荷物|にもつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{運送|うんそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{運送|うんそう}{費|ひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高|たか}い。

notes:
{運送|うんそう} refers to the transportation of goods and cargo.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運送|うんそう}する (to transport)
- {運送|うんそう}{会社|かいしゃ} (shipping/transport company)
- {運送|うんそう}{業|ぎょう} (transport industry)
- {運送|うんそう}{費|ひ} (shipping cost)

RELATED TERMS:
- {配送|はいそう}: delivery
- {輸送|ゆそう}: transportation (more formal)
- {宅配|たくはい}: home delivery
- {貨物|かもつ}: freight, cargo
